name: release handoff replay verification
rules: Replay verification is local deterministic and dependency-free by default.
Phase 13J bundle files are verified inside the bundle directory.
Checksum entries from CHECKSUMS.sha256 are verified relative to the repository root because they describe release files, not copied bundle members.
factoryctl smoke replay must run without [MISSING] handover entries.
LangGraph/OpenAI execution remains detected and policy-gated, not falsely claimed as active.
